children: Venu completed a $60 million sale-leaseback of the McKinney, Texas site for its planned entertainment complex, selling the land and specified improvements to STORE Capital while leasing the parcel back for 99 years. The initial annual ground rent is $5.7 million, subject to increases, and Venu retained ownership of the vertical improvements. The transaction documents also revise the city development arrangements, provide MEDC with collateral, and establish that Venu may receive reimbursement of up to $35 million if it meets specified occupancy-certificate deadlines. Venu used a portion of the sale proceeds to repay its Ryan bridge note.
